result.note: Tests the Green Strategic Partnership upgrade and the concrete outcomes of the May 2026 India–Norway talks, including the DPI triangular pact, the ISRO MoU and Norway joining the IPOI.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, India and Norway upgraded their bilateral ties on the sidelines of the Nordic summit. What is the new partnership called?
questions.explain: Prime Ministers Narendra Modi and Jonas Gahr Støre upgraded ties to a Green Strategic Partnership on 18 May 2026. At the same meeting they also signed a pact to jointly fund projects in the Global South.
questions.source: On Monday, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre upgraded ties to a Green Strategic Partnership and signed a pact to jointly fund projects in the Global South.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the outcomes of the India–Norway talks held in May 2026:
items: Under the triangular development cooperation agreement, Norway will export its digital public infrastructure model while India co-funds the projects.
The Indian Space Research Organisation signed an MoU with the Norwegian Space Agency.
Norway joined India's Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 reverses the roles. Under the triangular agreement, India's digital public infrastructure is rolled out in Global South countries with Norway co-funding the projects while India exports the model. Norway joining the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative is a notable signal from a NATO member with Arctic interests.
questions.source: Both sides signed a triangular development cooperation agreement to jointly roll out India's digital public infrastructure (DPI) in Global South countries, with Norway co-funding projects while India exports the model.
